name: Gilford
source:
"During hard times cry as much as you want. I'll accept everything about you."

The leader of the Deeks family's organization.
He bought Mana from a black market that his organization runs, but he isn't meddling into her life and in fact is quite apathetic.
He looks like the cruel leader of an underworld organization, but he is actually quite kind to his fellows.
